units.source_text: 男子听完，微笑的说：“就只要一条狗吗？

en.t: After listening, the man smiled and said, "You only want a dog?

units.source_text: 这么看来，你是一个没什么欲望，知足常乐的人。

en.t: From the look of it, you are someone with few desires, content and happy with what you have.

units.source_text: 单单这一点就让人很是令人佩服你，那我就送你一条旷世神犬吧！

en.t: That alone is enough to make me admire you, so I will give you an incomparable divine dog!

units.source_text: 我是葛城山里的独脚大仙。”

en.t: I am the One-Legged Great Immortal of Mount Katsuragi."

units.source_text: 独脚大仙说完这些，接着吹了一声尖利的口哨，一条雪白的狗从森林深处奔跑而来，经过之处落叶齐飞。

en.t: After saying this, the One-Legged Great Immortal blew a sharp whistle, and a snow-white dog came running from deep in the forest, scattering fallen leaves everywhere it passed.
